import urllib.request,json,re,collections,hashlib
url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gatehot59-star/corpus-legal-tarija/86d57c2790082b25b81554acdd20d77d86d59730/docs/agents/respuestas/2026-09-17-01-plan-integral-corpus-titan-full.md'
raw=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20).read(); rows=[]
for line in raw.decode().splitlines():
 if re.match(r'\| [A-I]\d\d \|',line):
  a=[c.strip() for c in line.strip('|').split('|')]; rows.append(dict(id=a[0],deps=[] if a[2]=='Inicio' else a[2].split(','),role=a[3],hours=int(a[4])))
ids={r['id'] for r in rows}; assert len(rows)==72 and len(ids)==72
assert all(0<r['hours']<=4 and set(r['deps'])<=ids for r in rows)
done=set()
while len(done)<len(ids):
 ready=[r for r in rows if r['id'] not in done and set(r['deps'])<=done]; assert ready,'cycle'; done.update(r['id'] for r in ready)
mult=dict(A05=4,C01=4,C02=4,C03=4,C05=6,C06=2,E01=4,G03=4,G04=4,G05=4); by=collections.Counter()
for r in rows: by[r['role']]+=r['hours']*mult.get(r['id'],1)
print(len(raw),hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(rows),sum(r['hours'] for r in rows),dict(by),sum(by.values()))
